test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL 2023 - Quant (Held on: 02 March 2023)
subject: maths
question: A rectangular park is 120 m long and 104 m wide. A 1-m wide path runs along the boundary of the park, remaining completely inside the park area. Thus, the outside edges of the path run along the boundary wall of the park. The inside edges of the path are marked with a white line of negligible thickness. If it costs ₹2.50 to mark each metre with the white line, then how much would it cost (in ₹) to fully mark the inside edges of the path?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Inner Perimeter = 2 × [(Length + Breadth) − 4 × path width]

Inner Perimeter = 2 × [(120 + 104) − 4 × 1] = 2 × 220 = 440 m

Total Cost = 440 × ₹2.50 = ₹1100.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1100.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of the park (L) = 120 m

Width of the park (B) = 104 m

Width of the path (w) = 1 m

Rate of marking = ₹2.50 per metre

**Formula Used:**

Inner Dimension = Outer Dimension − 2 × path width

Perimeter of Rectangle = 2 × (Length + Breadth)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/86fac2b6d70089aa3237113454a58a9cd00b67479146de7e58c81c35d11ac67f.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Inner Length (l) = 120 − (1 + 1) = 118 m

⇒ Inner Width (b) = 104 − (1 + 1) = 102 m

⇒ The inside edge of the path forms a rectangle with dimensions 118 m × 102 m.

⇒ Length of white line = Perimeter of the inner rectangle

⇒ Perimeter = 2 × (118 + 102)

⇒ Perimeter = 2 × 220 = 440 m

⇒ Total Cost = Perimeter × Rate

⇒ Total Cost = 440 × 2.50 = ₹1100.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1100.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Area of Path (Inside)

If a path of width 'w' is built inside a rectangle (L × B), its Area = 2w(L + B − 2w).

Area of Path (Outside)

If a path of width 'w' is built outside a rectangle (L × B), its Area = 2w(L + B + 2w).

Diagonal of Rectangle

The distance between opposite corners of the park is given by √(L² + B²).
